edit.statement: Every banknote of the Swiss National Bank's ninth series shows a hand and a globe as recurring motifs.
edit.subject: A ninth-series Swiss franc banknote
edit.scope: Only the six denominations of the ninth series (issued 2016 to 2019); earlier series are left aside.
